author: XBOX
description:
On this episode of the Official XBOX Podcast, we've travelled to Infinity Ward to discuss the upcoming release of Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4! We're sitting down with the devs and diving into the details when it comes the campaign, multiplayer, and DMZ to one of the biggest games of the year.

00:00 Introduction
00:26 Infinity Ward
01:30 Campaign and South Korea
03:49 Balancing new surprises with fan favorites
06:16 Exploration
07:11 New systems and modes in DMZ
07:35 Gunny
08:50 Kill Block
11:07 Ground War: Combat Outpost
13:32 XBOX Blueprint
14:28 What sets DMZ apart from other extraction games?
15:44 Story Missions, trait trees, and perks
18:33 What happened to Rex the dog?
19:08 Outro

Listen closely. That heartbeat never stopped. Whatever sleeps down there already knows you’re coming. 

Once Human’s biggest free Ocean expansion is coming October 22. Meet what waits beneath the waves! 

The strange world comes to the open sea—build your ultimate mobile ship base, survive the Sea-Land loop, dive into sunken ruins, and team up to confront The Sunken Lord, a kaiju-scale titan waiting in the deep. 

Once Human is already available now with XBOX Game Pass. To mark the launch, XBOX Game Pass Ultimate members can still claim the exclusive Once Human Launch Bundle through the Game Pass Perks gallery throughout the launch window.

author: XBOX
description:
Ordinary Oddness is a Nothing-Stays-Oddinary Open-World RPG. Since the Albinox Judgment, humans and Mythoids have lived side by side in Elysian Skies, a city suspended above a sea of clouds, sharing the same streets and the same everyday rules. Elysian Skies is now open for registration to all humans and Mythoids. As a Consulting Investigator certified by the Mythoids Investigation Agency, you'll open an agency on Breezeway Lane and take on commissions from humans and Mythoids alike. Rules will break, daily life will warp, and the truth isn't always comforting, but this city welcomes you back, oddball.
